title: Can I BEAT Tiny Chess?
summary: Tiny Chess on chess.com-style 4x4 board vs humans; small pieces at the board edge suggest a pocket/drop mechanic.
rules: Tiny House Chess (chess.com): 4x4 board; captured pieces can be placed back on the board (drops) (0:01).

Ferz moves like an X (one step diagonally); Wazir ('Bob') moves like a plus (one step orthogonally); Dragon Knight = a knight that can't jump (one square orthogonally then one diagonally, blocked by a piece on the orthogonal square) (0:01, 1:06, 2:08).
Pawns promote to Bob, Ferz or Dragon Knight (3:54).
1-minute games (2:32); goal: win three games vs unique opponents.
setup: 4x4: e.g. Black back rank B N B K with pawn(s); White mirrored with K, B, N, pawns.
evidence: Frame line (medium): 4x4, pocket pieces column. | RECHECK 2026-11-25 (transcript via analyze_video): 0:01 rules; 0:23 Bob; 1:06 + 2:08 dragon knight can't jump; 2:32 one minute; 3:54 promotion to bob/furs/dragon knight; 6:22 three unique opponents beaten.
